title.zh: 把警报计数封装成函数
title.en: Turn alert counting into a function

brief.zh: 实现 count_alerts(readings, limit)，返回达到或超过警戒线的读数个数。重复读数分别计算，空列表的结果是 0。
brief.en: Implement count_alerts(readings, limit) to return how many readings meet or exceed the limit. Count repeated readings separately and return 0 for an empty list.

hints.zh: 从 0 开始计数，只在读数 >= limit 时加 1。整个循环结束后再返回。
hints.en: Start the count at 0 and add 1 for each reading >= limit. Return after the loop ends.

label.en: Count readings that reach the limit
